title: Tet Run Mien Nam 2027 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Tet Run Mien Nam Review: 2025 Half Marathon Results and Weather
meta_description: Tet Run Mien Nam review from the 2025 race at Vinhomes Grand Park, Thu Duc: a 5am half-marathon start in misty 23°C to 24°C air, 1,619 finishers with a 2:22 median, and the 3:30 limit for 2027.
dek: What Ho Chi Minh City's pre-Tet half marathon was like in January 2025: a single 21 km through a decorated new township, a misty, saturated dawn, and how fast the field ran against the time limit now in place.
verdict: Enter if you want a festive, half-marathon-only race in the week before Tet, on the wide roads of a new township in Thu Duc. In 2025 the 21 km started at 5am in mist, at 23°C to 24°C and up to 100% humidity, and 1,619 runners finished with a median of 2:22. The field is solid: almost a third broke two hours. The 2027 race has a three-and-a-half-hour limit, which would have caught fewer than 1% of the 2025 finishers.

sections.heading: The 2025 Race: One Distance, Dressed for Tet
paragraphs: Tet Run Mien Nam is the southern half of a pair of pre-Lunar New Year half marathons, held on the same day as a northern race at Vinhomes Ocean Park 2 near Hanoi [5][6]. The 2025 race was on Sunday 19 January at Vinhomes Grand Park in Thu Duc, over 21 km only, starting at 5am [1][2].

The route stayed inside the Vinhomes Grand Park township [4], and the press described it as running through a colourful picture of a traditional Tet, in a green setting [3]. The organiser describes the venue's roads as green and shaded [5]. No route map, aid-station plan or cut-off was published for 2025.
The two races together drew about 2,100 runners [4]; the official results list 1,619 finishers in Ho Chi Minh City [8].

sections.heading: The Weather: Misty and Saturated
paragraphs: Tan Son Nhat airport, about 20 km west of the start, recorded 24°C with a 23°C dew point and 94% humidity at 5am, in mist that cut visibility to 4 km [7]. It cooled to 23°C and 100% humidity from 5.30am to 6.30am, with visibility down to 2 km, then 24°C at 7am and 7.30am, and 25°C at 8am and 8.30am, still in mist; the wind never rose above 4 knots [7].
The temperature was mild for the city, but the air was saturated and still. The median runner finished at about 7.20am at 24°C; even the slowest were done by 8.40am, before the morning warmed.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: A strong field. The race was won in 1:11:25 by a man and 1:23:45 by a woman, tenth place was 1:17:46, and tenth woman ran 1:35:05 [8]. The median finisher took 2:22:41 and the slowest tenth more than 3:12. Thirty-one per cent broke two hours and 58% broke 2:30, and 29% of finishers were women [8].
The 2027 race has a three-and-a-half-hour limit [6]. In 2025, 15 of 1,619 finishers (0.9%) took longer than that, the slowest 3:36:26 [8], so the limit is a concern only for walkers.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a single-distance half marathon with a festive, pre-Tet feel, township roads, and a field fast enough to pull you along: a two-hour runner finishes in the top third.
Think twice if you want to see the course and aid stations before entering: for 2027 the course map and race kit were still marked to be updated [6].

The 2027 race is on Sunday 24 January at Vinhomes Grand Park, with the expo on 23 January [6]. It is open to runners aged 16 and over, with a three-and-a-half-hour limit; the early-bird entry costs VND 678,000 and does not include a finisher shirt, and entries can be transferred for VND 100,000 until 18 December 2026 [6]. A 2026 edition was held at the same venue in early February [5].
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's entry pages, Vietnamese press reports, the full 2025 results and airport weather records.

faqs.question: How fast is the Tet Run Mien Nam field?
faqs.answer: Fairly quick. In 2025, 1,619 runners finished with a median of 2:22:41, and 31% broke two hours. It was won in 1:11:25 by a man and 1:23:45 by a woman, tenth place was 1:17:46, and 29% of finishers were women.

faqs.question: Is the Tet Run Mien Nam cut-off hard to make?
faqs.answer: Almost certainly. The 2027 limit is three and a half hours, and at the 2025 race only 15 of 1,619 finishers, under 1%, took longer than that; the slowest ran 3:36:26. Half the field finished inside 2:23, and the slowest tenth took a little over 3:12.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at Tet Run Mien Nam?
faqs.answer: Mild but saturated. At the 5am start in 2025, Tan Son Nhat airport recorded 24°C with 94% humidity and mist, cooling to 23°C at 100% humidity by 5.30am, with almost no wind. It was still only 25°C at 8.30am, so the whole race ran before the heat.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the 2025 edition (Sunday 19 January 2025), the only one for which we hold results; a 2026 edition ran in early February 2026 at the same venue but no results for it were found. Finish-time figures are Run SEA's analysis of the official SportStats results. The 5am start is from the SportStats event page. The 2,100-runner figure from VTC News covers both the Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi races. Weather is from Tan Son Nhat airport METAR, about 20 km west of Vinhomes Grand Park. No 2025 route map, aid plan, cut-off or runner account was found. No rating.
